storyline.real: Hamilton leads from pole, and Rosberg, who started from the pit lane, retires. Red Bull stop Vettel twice, the second time onto the softs to run to the flag. A safety car for debris comes out on lap 30 while Hamilton still owes a stop on the harder tyre; he builds a 25-second gap, rejoins just behind Vettel and passes him a lap later. Vettel finishes second, 13.5 s behind.
storyline.headline: Vettel beats Hamilton under the Marina Bay lights

hidden.label: Finish second without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Marina Bay, 2014, under the lights, nine laps in. You run Vettel, second behind Hamilton; Rosberg started from the pit lane. Hamilton still has to run the harder tyre before the flag. Hold second, and be ready if the race turns.
